title: Cheney and Bush as possible disclosure gatekeepers
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Cheney and Bush as possible disclosure gatekeepers, about 2000s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You hear Dick Cheny's name, you know, around uh you hear George W. Bush might have contemplated UFO disclosure.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that during the 2000s you hear the name of Dick Cheney, then US vice president, come up around the question of UFO secrets. He adds that President George W. Bush might have thought about disclosure, meaning publicly revealing what the government knows about UFOs. If true, it would mean the decision to keep or share such secrets reached the very top of the White House.
